works.title: Lithium, 2020
works.body:
An experimental drama written, directed, shot, and edited by Zoey Rose Best.

Lithium follows Elle in her downfall and recovery whilst living with Bipolar II

Staring Alyssa Berman as Elle.

works.title: Feminism From The Pole, 2017
works.body:
A short drama written, directed, shot, and edited by Zoey Rose Best.

When Troy threatens to reveal Ivy, who is behind the controversial blog 'From the Pole', she must decide if her anonymity is worth her pride.

Staring Gabi Gambino as Ivy.

works.title: Addicted a Latte, 2016
works.body:
A comedic- documentary created and edited by Zoey Rose Best.

A silly and intimate look into the lives of 4 college students and their relationship to caffeine.

Featuring Arielle Rebekah, Raechel Sontag, Dan McElrone, and Katie McGee.

works.title: Building a Home, 2013
works.body:
A documentary-short Written, Directed, Shot, and Edited by Zoey Rose Best

This film follows a weekend Habitat for Humanity build.
